purpose: Prospectively close the V-E1 public input-mapping gap without inventing history or opening outcomes before the frozen interval is terminal and independently accepted.

activation.rule: intervalStartUtc is the first UTC midnight at least 24 hours after independentlyAcceptedCaptureReadyAtUtc; intervalEndExclusiveUtc is exactly durationMs later; maturityAtUtc is exactly maturityLagMs after intervalEndExclusiveUtc.
activationEvidenceRequired: no prior outcome record at or after the derived interval start

universe.selectionRule: The scored sample contains every non-pseudo Volume detector proposal accepted and prospectively captured during the frozen interval whose symbol is proven under the point-in-time exchangeInfo and captured configuration bound to that proposal to be TRADING, Spot-enabled, USDT-quoted, and not blocked. No volume threshold or independently reconstructed symbol universe is introduced.

publicCapture.rawByteRule: Record exact application payload bytes after transport decompression and before JSON parse.
publicCapture.depthProtocol: Buffer diff-depth before the REST snapshot, discard buffered events whose final update ID is at or below lastUpdateId, require the first retained event to cover lastUpdateId+1, then require continuity; a gap invalidates the generation and requires a new snapshot.
pointInTimeStateRequired: exchangeInfo raw bytes and symbol filters
accepted non-pseudo detector proposal raw bytes and identity
measurement policy raw bytes and SHA-256

detectorBinding.entryRule: For each accepted detector proposal, create at most one shadow record-only entry at the first accepted source-native 2-second cut bound to that proposal.
detectorBinding.entryFillRule: Walk only the exact synchronized displayed opposite-side depth at the accepted entry cut; reject the lifecycle if the full 10.00 USDT cannot be modeled exactly under point-in-time filters.
detectorBinding.exitRule: Use the first accepted source-native 2-second cut whose monotonic receive time is at or after entryReceiveMonotonicNs plus 60000000000 nanoseconds.

economics.smokeExclusion: SMOKE_MECHANICS_ONLY — validates capture, schema, clocks, chain/dedupe, checksums, and serialization using synthetic or pre-interval data. Smoke rows are permanently excluded from the VE2 universe, sample counts, economics, uncertainty, N-3, and every profitability or capacity claim. A passing smoke is not a strategy sample, fill, return, fee or slippage measurement, drawdown, capacity proof, edge, or execution authority.

consumerGate.openCondition: The derived prospective interval is complete, maturityAtUtc has passed, the full evidence chain and deterministic lifecycle replay pass, and the exact terminal evidence candidate is independently accepted.
